name: io.github.dawnwood-ai/dramapack
title: dramapack
description: Short-drama delivery packs, -14 LUFS mastering, subtitle safe areas, clean masters, rights checks.

environmentVariables.name: DRAMAPACK_FFMPEG
environmentVariables.description: Path to ffmpeg (default: ffmpeg on PATH)

environmentVariables.name: DRAMAPACK_FFPROBE
environmentVariables.description: Path to ffprobe (default: ffprobe on PATH)

environmentVariables.name: DRAMAPACK_VLM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: OpenAI-compatible base URL for audit vlm checks (your provider or a local model)

environmentVariables.name: DRAMAPACK_VLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: API key for that endpoint (any non-empty string for local servers)

environmentVariables.name: DRAMAPACK_VLM_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: vision-capable model name for audit vlm checks
